description.name: Chatwoot Live Chat & CRM
description.tagline: Seamless Chatwoot live chat widget integration with logged-in user auto-sync and Agent CRM sidebar for WHMCS
description.long: A modern, complete WHMCS addon module by Bahari IT that seamlessly integrates Chatwoot Live Chat into your WHMCS client area and public pages, automatically identifies logged-in clients with HMAC identity verification, and embeds a powerful WHMCS CRM Dashboard App inside Chatwoot for support agents.
features: Automatic Chatwoot Live Chat widget injection into client area and public pages
Logged-in client auto-sync (Name, Email, Phone, Client ID, Balance)
HMAC Identity Verification to prevent user impersonation
Visibility control: Show to all visitors or logged-in clients only
Chatwoot Agent CRM Dashboard App displaying client services, invoices & tickets
One-click actions inside Chatwoot: Login as client, view full profile
Compatible with app.chatwoot.com and self-hosted Chatwoot installations
